title: Name input label and on-theme toasts
acceptance: The collector name input has an accessible name 'Your name' (aria-label) with no layout change; placeholder kept; unit test by label

Normal toasts use the app's tokens (popover surface, foreground text, border, primary Undo button, matching close button) instead of sonner's built-in black/white dark palette; contrast meets AA for text and the Undo button; done via sonner's supported CSS variables/classNames, not !important
Toast position, duration, copy, closeButton, richColors semantics (success/error variants) and e2e-visible roles/text unchanged
Before/after screenshots of the pin toast (vault-pinned scene) at 390 and 320x568, described from the images
